methodologyNotes: The roster covers 10 high-search countertop/personal blender models spanning budget to premium, all currently sold or recently available in the US. Independently re-verified 2026-06-15 against official manufacturer pages (vitamix.com, sharkninja.com/ninjakitchen.com, nutribullet.com, breville.com, blendtec.com, oster.com) and major retail/review listings (Walmart, Amazon, Best Buy, Home Depot, Sur La Table, RTINGS). Motor wattage is rated continuous draw unless labeled 'peak' in the provenance; several models (Ninja, Oster, KitchenAid, Cleanblend) publish PEAK watts only and are flagged as such. dishwasher_safe reflects whether the main jar/pitcher (not the motor base, not the blade assembly) is dishwasher-safe per manufacturer. noise_dampening reflects a built-in acoustic enclosure / integrated sound-suppression system (not optional accessories); no model in this list ships with a full enclosure, so all are false. warranty_years reflects the STANDARD included full/limited warranty (NOT extended drive-only warranties). Prices are US MSRP or current typical retail price in USD. NULL is used wherever a value could not be corroborated. accessedAt 2026-06-15.

products.name: Vitamix 5200
products.priceNote: MSRP, Standard Getting Started package, vitamix.com
products.provenance: VERIFIED on vitamix.com product page (live): price $499.95, 7-Year Full Warranty, 64 oz BPA-free Tritan container, Variable 1-10 dial plus High switch (no preset programs). Motor rated 11.5A x 120V = ~1380W continuous; Vitamix markets as '2 HP'. Container not dishwasher-safe (hand-wash / self-clean cycle). No built-in sound enclosure. Release year 2007 confirmed. Corroboration source replaced with CNN Underscored review (original Shouldit URL not independently verifiable).

products.name: Vitamix Ascent Series A3500
products.priceNote: MSRP, vitamix.com (live, in-stock at research date)
products.provenance: VERIFIED on vitamix.com (live): $699.95, 10-Year Full Warranty, 64 oz container, 2.2 HP (12A x 120V = ~1440W). The FIVE program settings are Smoothies, Hot Soups, Dips & Spreads, Frozen Desserts, and SELF-CLEANING (the draft's vague 'plus one more' is corrected: the 5th is Self-Clean; count of 5 is accurate per Walmart listing title and vitamix.com). Variable dial 1-10 plus Pulse. Container dishwasher-safe. No full acoustic enclosure -> noise_dampening false. priceNote corrected: page is live/in-stock, not 'Retired/Coming Soon'.

products.name: Ninja Professional Plus Blender with Auto-iQ (BN701)
products.provenance: VERIFIED on sharkninja.com (live): price $119.99, 72 oz Total Crushing Pitcher (64 oz max liquid), 3 Auto-iQ presets (smoothies, frozen drinks, nutrient extractions), dishwasher-safe pitcher and blades, 1-Year Limited Warranty. motor_watts 1400 is PEAK (page states 1,200W operating / 1,400 peak watts) - flagged peak per methodology. speed_settings=3 (Low/Med/High plus Pulse). Corroboration switched to Amazon official listing (matches all specs).

products.priceNote: Launch MSRP per PR Newswire; current retail ~$249-$289

products.name: Breville the Super Q (BBL920)
products.priceNote: Current retail price at Best Buy / Sur La Table / breville.com
products.provenance: VERIFIED on breville.com (live): 1800W motor, 68 oz jug, 12 speed settings, 5 one-touch programs, 10-year warranty (per Breville). NOTE: some Best Buy SKU titles list '1600W' but the official Breville page and RTINGS confirm 1800W -> kept 1800. The Super Q has noise-suppression in its cooling/enclosure design but no full acoustic enclosure -> noise_dampening false. Release year 2019 confirmed. Corroboration switched to RTINGS (primary spec-tested source).
